nina.l: Hi all, first-day question  I ran the Buildkite pipeline for redwood/services-auth and the container publish step fails with a 403 from GHCR. I'm blocked on my first PR. Anyone seen this?

buildkite-bot: Build #5 failed - step: publish-container (exit code: 1)
```
# pushing image to ghcr.io/redwood/services-auth:pr-12
The push refers to repository [ghcr.io/redwood/services-auth]
unauthorized: GET https://ghcr.io/v2/redwood/services-auth/manifests/latest: unauthorized
Error: failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood/services-auth'
```

oliver: Welcome Nina! 403/unauthorized on GHCR usually means the PAT used for docker login doesn't have the correct scope (packages:write) or the pipeline secret isn't set. Which auth method does the pipeline use? DOCKER_USER/DOCKER_PASS or `docker login` with GITHUB_TOKEN?

nina.l: The pipeline runs a step that does `echo \"$DOCKER_PASS\" | docker login ghcr.io -u $DOCKER_USER --password-stdin` then `docker push`. I don't see DOCKER_PASS in pipeline env. I assumed it would be there.

devex-sue: For GHCR we use a short-lived registry bot token called `registry-robot` (scoped packages:write, repo) stored as SECRET_GHCR_TOKEN in Buildkite. New hires don't get it by default. We prefer providing access via the infra-managed robot rather than personal PATs.

ci-oncall-bot: Onboarding note: Do not create personal GitHub tokens for registry writes. Request a registry-robot token via #eng-infra. See pinned onboarding steps.

oliver: @infra-ops can add a masked SECRET_GHCR_TOKEN to the pipeline for this repo. Alternatively, switch publish to use the release-operator identity (service account) so tokens aren't person-bound.

infra-ops: Adding SECRET_GHCR_TOKEN (masked) to the pipeline now. We'll scope it to ghcr:packages write and repo access where needed.

nina.l: Thanks  I'll re-run after it's added. Quick Q: if I add the token will I need to change DOCKER_USER too?

oliver: When using a PAT the user is your GitHub username or `registry-robot` service account; pipeline expects DOCKER_USER=registry-robot and DOCKER_PASS=$SECRET_GHCR_TOKEN. We inject both envs masked.

nina.l: Re-ran and the docker push progressed past login  now shows \"digest: sha256:...\" and 202 Accepted. Looks good :tada:

devex-sue: Follow-ups: 1) eng-infra to add registry-robot to onboarding checklist and automation to provision per-repo tokens for new hires when needed. 2) Add pipeline preflight that errors with a clear message if SECRET_GHCR_TOKEN missing.

infra-ops: Will file a tiny PR to onboarding docs and open a ticket for pipeline preflight. Glad that unblocked your first PR, Nina!

nina.l: Huge thanks everyone  appreciate the quick unblock. I'll mark the onboarding checklist item done.

buildkite-bot: Build #5 (re-run) passed - step: publish-container :white_check_mark:
